capabilities: Convert a selected Unix timestamp into labeled UTC and device-local date-time values
Choose between seconds and milliseconds interpretations before applying a result
Insert the readable value beside the original or replace the selection
Convert a selected column of timestamps row by row (Pro)
Save IANA time zones and an output format template for comparison (Pro)
extras: Freemium: single-timestamp conversion is free; column conversion, saved time zones and saved formats require Pro via GitHub Sponsors. The plugin makes no network requests until sign-in; sign-in uses the GitHub device flow and stores the token in Obsidian's secret storage. Untracked areas include phone/tablet, Linux, screen readers and third-party themes.
problem: Raw Unix timestamps in notes are unreadable, and a bare number does not reveal whether it is in seconds or milliseconds.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Unix timestamp converter that turns a selected integer into a readable UTC or device-local date-time and inserts it into the note.
